info.title: Tawasol al Nukhba Partner API
info.description: Dynamic published catalog managed centrally in Tawasol al Nukhba. Treat catalog.version as an opaque string. Cache catalog display for at most cache_ttl_seconds; use fresh server quotes for purchases. Package IDs, HMAC and checkout remain compatible. All partner money fields are integer halalas. Additive organization intake and manual financial offers. Existing individual requests and signed payment paths remain compatible. amount=null means not yet priced; zero is a free approved offer, not a confirmed payment. Partner API supports single-post requests only.

get.summary: Download the original central paid service invoice as PDF
get.description: Signed server-to-server download. Requires matching partner and customer ownership and confirmed payment. Refunded paid orders retain their original invoice. No public URL or Tawasol browser session. Success is binary PDF; errors retain the standard JSON envelope.
